issue_context.title: Bug: Hide deleted items from the tags widget
issue_context.body: ### Description I have encountered a problem related to label display and file deletion. When labels are displayed on the home page and a file with a label is deleted, if the category containing the file remains on the home page, the file appears under a different name both on the home page and in the search results when clicking on the category name for a search. Additionally, the displayed path leads to the Recycle Bin. ### Steps To Reproduce 1. Add tags in the homepage 2. Add File or Folder to tag 3. Delete file or folder without removing tag 4. Go to the homepage 5. Observe that the deleted item in recycle bin is still displayed in the list ### Requirements Hide deleted items from the tags widget ### Files Version 6.5.22.0 ### Windows Version 22H2 22621.1992 ### Log File
